subject: Chemistry
title: Chemical Kinetics
summary: Chemical kinetics batata hai reactions kitni tez chalti hain. Rate = time ke saath concentration ka change, stoichiometric coefficient se divide karke, taaki har species ke liye same aaye.
Rate law (rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ) experiment se milta hai. Order (x + y) 0, fractional ya whole ho sakta hai; molecularity sirf elementary steps ki hoti hai aur hamesha whole number.
Integrated rate laws: zero order [A] = [A]₀ − kt (t½ ∝ [A]₀); first order ln([A]₀/[A]) = kt (t½ = 0.693/k, concentration se independent).
Temperature ke saath rates tezi se badhte hain (Arrhenius: k = Ae^{−Ea/RT}) kyunki zyada molecules ki energy Ea se upar hoti hai. Catalyst Ea ghataata hai, ΔH ya equilibrium nahi badalta.

formulas.name: Rate of reaction
formulas.formula: for aA + bB → cC + dD:  rate = −(1/a)d[A]/dt = −(1/b)d[B]/dt = (1/c)d[C]/dt
formulas.mistake: Coefficient se divide karo — A ke gaayab hone ki rate = a × rate, bhoolo mat.

formulas.name: Rate law
formulas.mistake: x aur y experiment se aate hain, balanced equation se nahi — galat mat lo.

formulas.name: Units of k
formulas.formula: (mol L⁻¹)¹⁻ⁿ s⁻¹:  zero order mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹;  first s⁻¹;  second L mol⁻¹ s⁻¹

formulas.name: Zero-order reaction
formulas.when: Saturated catalyst surface par reactions, photochemical reactions.
formulas.mistake: Zero order mein t½ initial concentration ke saath badhta hai — first order jaisa constant nahi.

formulas.name: First-order reaction
formulas.mistake: First order ka t½ initial concentration par depend nahi karta — dhyan rakho.

formulas.name: First-order shortcuts
formulas.formula: t₇₅% = 2 t½;  t₈₇.₅% = 3 t½;  t₉₉.₉% ≈ 10 t½;  t₉₉% = 2 t₉₀%

formulas.name: Pseudo-first-order
formulas.formula: a second-order reaction with one reactant in large excess behaves as first order
formulas.when: Esters ka acid hydrolysis, cane sugar ka inversion.

formulas.name: Arrhenius equation
formulas.mistake: Kelvin lo, aur Ea joules mein ho to R = 8.314 J mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ — units mix mat karo.

formulas.name: Collision theory
formulas.formula: rate = Z_AB e^{−Ea/RT} × P  (P = steric/orientation factor)
formulas.when: Sirf kuch collisions hi kyun react karti hain.

examples.problem: 2N₂O₅ → 4NO₂ + O₂. NO₂ 2.8 × 10⁻³ mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹ se banta hai. N₂O₅ ke gaayab hone ki rate?

examples.title: Data se order
examples.problem: [A] double karne par rate chaar guna. A mein order?

examples.title: Activation energy
examples.problem: 300 K se 310 K par rate double. Ea?

examples.title: Zero-order half-life
examples.problem: Zero order, [A]₀ = 0.5 M, k = 0.01 mol L⁻¹ s⁻¹. t½?

topics.title: Average and instantaneous rate
topics.explain: Average rate = interval par Δ[R]/Δt; instantaneous rate = concentration–time curve ka kisi point par slope. Reactants khatam hone ke saath rate aam taur par ghatta hai.

topics.title: Factors affecting rate
topics.explain: Concentration (ya pressure), temperature, catalyst, solids ka surface area, aur photochemical reactions ke liye light.

topics.title: Order vs molecularity
topics.explain: Order experimental hai, zero ya fractional ho sakta hai aur poori reaction ka hota hai. Molecularity theoretical, whole number (1, 2, kabhi-kabhi 3) aur sirf elementary steps ke liye. Complex reactions mein sabse dheema step rate law tay karta hai.

topics.title: Graphs to identify order
topics.explain: Zero order: [A] vs t seedhi line (slope −k). First order: ln[A] (ya log[A]) vs t seedhi line (slope −k ya −k/2.303). Rate vs [A] zero order mein flat aur first order mein origin se seedhi line.

topics.title: Activation energy and catalysts
topics.explain: Sirf woh takraate molecules react karte hain jinki energy ≥ Ea aur orientation sahi ho. Catalyst kam Ea wala naya raasta deta hai, forward aur backward dono ko barabar tez karta hai, khatam nahi hota, aur ΔH, ΔG ya K nahi badalta.

topics.title: Effect of temperature (Maxwell distribution)
topics.explain: T badhane par energy distribution shift hota hai aur Ea se upar wale molecules ka fraction (Ea ke baad ka area) har 10 K par lagbhag double hota hai. ln k vs 1/T seedhi line, slope −Ea/R aur intercept ln A.

ratta: k = Ae^{−Ea/RT};  slope of ln k vs 1/T = −Ea/R.
Catalyst lowers Ea; no change in ΔH or K.
